plugins.name: soundcheck
plugins.description: 52 security skills covering OWASP Web Top 10:2025, LLM Top 10:2025, API Security Top 10:2023, and systems-software bug classes (memory-API misuse, crypto-library wiring, privilege handling, concurrency, numeric trust-boundary), plus three review modes (PR gate, full scan, contract review). Auto-invokes on vulnerable code and rewrites it inline.
